decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory closely tied to the core trailer business, its option value is still likely higher than the small cost of keeping it available.
This prominently marketed box trailer series fits the firm’s main capabilities and customer base, so there is little reason to abandon it without clearer negative evidence.
The car transporter line is more niche and likely costlier to carry, but its continued marketing after launch suggests enough unresolved upside to justify keeping it for now.
The low-bed trailer series is a strong strategic fit with the firm’s established transport equipment portfolio and was given high visibility, which supports continuation.
This cover series complements the trailer range, supports cross-selling, and likely requires limited incremental commitment relative to its market option value.
Although another box trailer series creates some overlap and raises the chance of later rationalization, it still leverages core know-how and remains worth retaining absent clear failure signals.
